svg.text: The tree lives on the CPU, the KV lives in the GPU pool
State after step 4 of the running example. A node's value is a list of slot numbers, one per token.
CPU memory: the radix tree (token ids and slot numbers only)
GPU memory: the KV pool (80 slots, page size 1 token)
One slot holds the K and V of one token in every layer. Llama-3.1-8B: 128 KiB per slot, so SYS uses 8 × 128 KiB = 1 MiB.
Row of chat 2, turn 1 (16 tokens): the slots of the path SYS → C2.1, gathered by attention
